messages:
taylor: Heads up — seeing a p95 latency uptick for quant-v4b on Dedicated after runtime roll 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0. p95 jumped ~40% (180ms -> 250ms) starting ~09:10 UTC. Short repro attached.
nav: Thanks. Can you paste the sample request/ids? @deploy-bot can we open a soft-pin to 3.2.0 on pool `dedicated-gpu-1` while we triage? Prefer minimal blast radius.
deploy-bot: Pin request created: PIN-8721. Details: pin runtime=3.2.0 for model_group=quant-v4b on pool=dedicated-gpu-1. Runbook=#RR-472. Approve with `/approve-pin PIN-8721` or `/reject-pin PIN-8721`.
rebecca: +1 to pin while we investigate. Suggest change window: immediate, rollback window = 2h. @sre-oncall any objections re: alerting/SLAs?
sre-oncall: No objections. 2h rollback window fine. I'll add temporary alerts for p50/p95 and error-rate spikes. If p95 > 220ms we'll trigger auto-fallback.
nav: Plan: canary 10% traffic in us-west1 -> monitor 10m -> ramp to 30% over 30m. Fallback policy: if p95>220ms for 5m, route back to 3.3.0 -> or actually fallback to pinned 3.2.0 depending on route. I'll execute after approvals.
taylor: Repro snippet (request id included):
```
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"quant-v4b","prompt":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":512}
# sample logs:
[09:11:23] request_id=abc123 queue_ms=12 exec_ms=230 total=250
[09:11:24] request_id=abc124 queue_ms=10 exec_ms=180 total=190
```
prateek: SDK note: SDK v1.4.0 introduces runtime-specific kernel selection. If we pin to 3.2.0 some customers using SDK v1.4 may hit minor performance variance. Recommendation: add compatibility header in the platform response for pinned sessions, and include an SDK shim for 1.4. Quick config workaround:
```
response.headers['X-Runtime-Compatible'] = '3.2.0'
# fallback logic in client: prefer header value for optimized kernels
```
rebecca: I'll author a short release note + customer advisory for Dedicated customers and add a line to the changelog: "soft-pin runtime 3.2.0 for quant-v4b due to p95 regression with 3.3.0". @deploy-bot please mark changelog when pin is applied.
deploy-bot: Action: PIN-8721 approved by rebecca. Pin applied: runtime=3.2.0 pinned on pool=dedicated-gpu-1 at 2723456798 by nav. Canary started at 2723456799. Auto-fallback policy active (p95 threshold 220ms).
taylor: Monitoring: p95 returned to baseline within ~12m of canary. Will keep observing for the 2h window. posting quick dashboard snapshot link: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/abc123
sre-oncall: Copy. I'll keep watch and close the runbook when window ends. If we see any model output drift open an incident and tag #prod-models.
nav: Next steps for engineering: reproduce locally with runtime 3.3.0 to isolate kernel change, try reverting kernel selection flags and run unit perf tests. I'll file issue #612 with the logs and kernel diffs.
rebecca: Thanks all :thumbsup:
